author: bld-connreconnect
scope: Sol review: 5 connectorHealth strings in 8 languages against plain words, no dashes, strengths for release fixes and no No limits in headlines. Original author bld-connreconnect; Sol copyrev-int4 corrected German unverified and Spanish and Portuguese computer wording before reviewing the final text. These messages describe current status and recovery, not release fix announcements.

en:connectorHealth.unverified.text: Murage could not check {app} just now. It will try again.
en:connectorHealth.unverified.en: Murage could not check {app} just now. It will try again.
en:connectorHealth.unverified.note: Names the app check and the retry in ordinary words. The temporary status is honest; it does not claim that the app needs reconnection.

en:connectorHealth.signIn.text: {connector} needs you to sign in again
en:connectorHealth.signIn.en: {connector} needs you to sign in again
en:connectorHealth.signIn.note: The heading names the affected app and the next action. No technical error, dash or permission level appears.

en:connectorHealth.reconnect.note: A short verb labels the recovery button clearly and matches the action it opens.

en:connectorHealth.reconnectApp.note: The accessible button label identifies the affected app with {connector}; it remains clear when several apps are listed.

en:connectorHealth.computer.note: The immediately preceding heading names the app, so it has a clear antecedent. The sentence gives a short action and directs the person to their computer.

de:connectorHealth.unverified.text: Murage konnte {app} gerade nicht prüfen. Murage versucht es später erneut.
de:connectorHealth.unverified.en: Murage could not check {app} just now. It will try again.
de:connectorHealth.unverified.note: Corrected Es wird es to an explicit Murage subject and a clear later retry. The temporary check result and {app} remain intact.

de:connectorHealth.signIn.en: {connector} needs you to sign in again
de:connectorHealth.signIn.note: A natural short German heading explains that {connector} needs another sign in, without a technical diagnosis or a permission level.

de:connectorHealth.reconnect.note: Erneut verbinden is a familiar action label; the infinitive is appropriate on a button.

de:connectorHealth.reconnectApp.note: The app name followed by erneut verbinden reads naturally as a German action label and retains {connector}.

de:connectorHealth.computer.text: Verbinde die App auf deinem Computer erneut.
de:connectorHealth.computer.note: The informal Verbinde and deinem fit the German voice. App and Computer make the recovery target and place explicit.

es:connectorHealth.unverified.text: Murage no pudo comprobar {app} en este momento. Volverá a intentarlo.
es:connectorHealth.unverified.en: Murage could not check {app} just now. It will try again.
es:connectorHealth.unverified.note: Comprobar and volver a intentarlo explain the check and retry naturally. It keeps {app} and does not suggest an expired account.

es:connectorHealth.signIn.text: Necesitas volver a iniciar sesión en {connector}
es:connectorHealth.signIn.en: {connector} needs you to sign in again
es:connectorHealth.signIn.note: The informal necesitas heading gives a clear sign in action and preserves {connector}; no permission level or dash appears.

es:connectorHealth.reconnect.note: Volver a conectar is a familiar Spanish button action, without jargon.

es:connectorHealth.reconnectApp.note: The action names {connector}, so multiple reconnect buttons remain distinguishable.

es:connectorHealth.computer.text: Vuelve a conectar la aplicación en tu ordenador.
es:connectorHealth.computer.note: Corrected conectarlo to conectar la aplicación, removing the unclear masculine pronoun. Tu ordenador states where to act.

fr:connectorHealth.unverified.text: Murage n’a pas pu vérifier {app} pour le moment. Il réessaiera.
fr:connectorHealth.unverified.en: Murage could not check {app} just now. It will try again.
fr:connectorHealth.unverified.note: Vérifier and réessaiera explain the temporary check result and retry in natural French, with {app} preserved.

fr:connectorHealth.signIn.en: {connector} needs you to sign in again
fr:connectorHealth.signIn.note: Tu dois uses the required informal voice. Se reconnecter à {connector} gives the heading a clear next action.

fr:connectorHealth.reconnect.note: Reconnecter is a short conventional French action label that matches the button.

fr:connectorHealth.reconnectApp.note: The infinitive and {connector} make the action clear for each affected app.

fr:connectorHealth.computer.text: Reconnecte cette application sur ton ordinateur.
fr:connectorHealth.computer.note: Reconnecte, cette application and ton ordinateur explicitly give the action, target and place in the informal voice.

hi:connectorHealth.unverified.text: Murage अभी {app} की जाँच नहीं कर सका। वह फिर कोशिश करेगा।
hi:connectorHealth.unverified.en: Murage could not check {app} just now. It will try again.
hi:connectorHealth.unverified.note: जाँच and फिर कोशिश explain the check and retry in everyday Hindi. The message retains {app} and does not claim a sign in is required.

hi:connectorHealth.signIn.text: {connector} में फिर से साइन इन करें
hi:connectorHealth.signIn.en: {connector} needs you to sign in again
hi:connectorHealth.signIn.note: फिर से साइन इन करें is a familiar polite Hindi instruction. The heading identifies {connector} without a permission level.

hi:connectorHealth.reconnect.note: फिर से कनेक्ट करें clearly labels the reconnect action with familiar Hindi usage.

hi:connectorHealth.reconnectApp.note: The को construction ties the reconnect action to {connector} and keeps the app placeholder unchanged.

hi:connectorHealth.computer.text: इसे अपने कंप्यूटर पर फिर से कनेक्ट करें।
hi:connectorHealth.computer.note: इसे refers to the app named in the heading. अपने कंप्यूटर पर and फिर से कनेक्ट करें give a familiar place and action.

ja:connectorHealth.unverified.text: Murage は今、{app} を確認できませんでした。後でもう一度試します。
ja:connectorHealth.unverified.en: Murage could not check {app} just now. It will try again.
ja:connectorHealth.unverified.note: 確認できませんでした and 後でもう一度試します accurately describe an unsuccessful check and later retry, with {app} preserved.

ja:connectorHealth.signIn.text: {connector} に再度サインインしてください
ja:connectorHealth.signIn.en: {connector} needs you to sign in again
ja:connectorHealth.signIn.note: The polite サインインしてください instruction names {connector}. It is suitable for this recovery heading and contains no permission level.

ja:connectorHealth.reconnect.note: 再接続 is the standard concise Japanese label for this button action.

ja:connectorHealth.reconnectApp.note: The を particle ties 再接続 to {connector}, identifying each app in a list of actions.

ja:connectorHealth.computer.text: コンピューターで再接続してください。
ja:connectorHealth.computer.note: The preceding heading supplies the app. コンピューターで再接続してください is a natural polite Japanese instruction with a clear place and action.

pt-br:connectorHealth.unverified.text: O Murage não conseguiu verificar {app} agora. Ele tentará novamente.
pt-br:connectorHealth.unverified.en: Murage could not check {app} just now. It will try again.
pt-br:connectorHealth.unverified.note: Verificar and tentará novamente describe the check and retry in ordinary Brazilian Portuguese without inventing an account problem.

pt-br:connectorHealth.signIn.en: {connector} needs you to sign in again
pt-br:connectorHealth.signIn.note: Entrar novamente gives the reader a familiar sign in action and retains {connector}; no permission level or dash appears.

pt-br:connectorHealth.reconnect.note: Reconectar is the standard concise action label in Brazilian Portuguese.

pt-br:connectorHealth.reconnectApp.note: Reconectar followed by {connector} identifies which app the button will reconnect.

pt-br:connectorHealth.computer.text: Reconecte o app no seu computador.
pt-br:connectorHealth.computer.note: Added o app as the missing reconnect object. No seu computador states where the person should complete the action.

zh:connectorHealth.unverified.text: Murage 暂时无法检查 {app}，稍后会重试。
zh:connectorHealth.unverified.en: Murage could not check {app} just now. It will try again.
zh:connectorHealth.unverified.note: 暂时无法检查 and 稍后会重试 accurately state the temporary check result and retry with everyday wording and {app} intact.

zh:connectorHealth.signIn.en: {connector} needs you to sign in again
zh:connectorHealth.signIn.note: 请重新登录 names the next action for {connector}. The heading is concise and uses no permission level.

zh:connectorHealth.reconnect.note: 重新连接 is a concise familiar label for the reconnect action.

zh:connectorHealth.reconnectApp.note: The label combines 重新连接 with {connector}, identifying the app when several buttons appear.

zh:connectorHealth.computer.note: The preceding heading supplies the app. 请在电脑上重新连接 is a concise polite instruction giving the place and action.
